introText: Ghost Tequila shows growing U.S. presence with nationwide availability, rising sales, and strong consumer ratings.

notableHighlight.title: RNDC distribution
notableHighlight.description: Ghost Tequila signed a U.S. national distribution agreement with Republic National Distributing Company (RNDC), a foundational wholesale milestone that enabled broad multi-state retail and on-premise expansion.
notableHighlight.impact: Anchors route-to-market scale beyond DTC and select regional brokers, supporting the brand’s nationwide shelf presence today.

closingText: Overall momentum points to continued distribution gains and sustained demand in the spicy tequila niche.
